label.zh: 蓝白模模 · zippzipp_ · 第2名

text.en: MTGO ran a special Standard event this week, culminating in a weekend final. Players could qualify with a Challenge Top 8 or a 5–0 League finish during the week. The final drew 129 players, and Dimir Midrange dominated, still using one copy each of [[card:Yuriko, Hope from the Shadows|Yuriko, Hope from the Shadows]] and [[card:Theorix Charm|Theorix Charm]]. The runner-up was Azorius Momo, with a single [[card:Guiding Hydra|Guiding Hydra]] in the main deck as a tutor target for [[card:Starfield Shepherd|Starfield Shepherd]]: deck:524eba2341891ddb59d7
text.zh: 本周MO标准搞活动，周末有一场总决赛，周中挑战赛8强或者League5-0可以参加。最后总决赛有129人参加，蓝黑中速席卷，依旧是[[card:Yuriko, Hope from the Shadows|希望之影百合子]]和[[card:Theorix Charm|论析护符]]各挂一张的版本。亚军是蓝白模模，主牌带了一张[[card:Guiding Hydra|多头龙向导]]作为[[card:Starfield Shepherd|星空牧者]]导师的目标：deck:524eba2341891ddb59d7

label.zh: 洁斯凯模模 · AFitzsimmons · 第7名

text.en: A Jeskai Momo version with [[card:Frostcliff Siege|Frostcliff Siege]] also reached the Top 8: deck:3e64f2a13a79d35110e4
text.zh: 还有带[[card:Frostcliff Siege|围攻霜崖]]的洁斯凯模模版本拿下八强：deck:3e64f2a13a79d35110e4

label.zh: 蓝黑蜘蛛侠 · TheSandwichKing · 第2名

text.en: As for this week's metagame shifts, the Excruciator decks found a new creature for Spider-Man to copy: [[card:Uldaros Theorix|Uldaros Theorix]]. Many builds have moved [[card:Doomsday Excruciator|Doomsday Excruciator]] to the sideboard, or even cut it entirely. Versions without Excruciator had appeared before, and this week's report now groups all these builds under Dimir Spider-Man rather than tracking them separately. [[card:Seasoned Cryomancer|Seasoned Cryomancer]] and [[card:Theorix Charm|Theorix Charm]] also fit the strategy extremely well. There are versions with [[card:Null Summoner|Null Summoner]], too. This build finished second this week: deck:af9339e5c032ae7b8c75
text.zh: 本周的环境变化方面，拷打魔系套牌找到了新的蜘蛛侠复制目标：[[card:Uldaros Theorix|乌达洛论析]]。很多套牌都开始把拷打魔放进备牌，甚至备牌都不带了。以前也有不带拷打魔的版本，本周周报把所有这些套牌整合成了蓝黑蜘蛛侠一个大类，不再分开统计。同时[[card:Seasoned Cryomancer|干练凛寒术士]]和[[card:Theorix Charm|论析护符]]也同样非常适合这个思路。还有带[[card:Null Summoner|虚空唤师]]的版本。本周拿下一个亚军：deck:af9339e5c032ae7b8c75

label.zh: 苏勒台掘坟 · Martin_Dominguez · 第7名

text.en: Sultai Reanimator, another [[card:Superior Spider-Man|Superior Spider-Man]] deck, has also adopted [[card:Seasoned Cryomancer|Seasoned Cryomancer]], while [[card:Something Worth Saving|Something Worth Saving]] is a straight upgrade over [[card:Cache Grab|Cache Grab]]: deck:43587beb61363b53cb36
text.zh: 同样是[[card:Superior Spider-Man|究极蜘蛛侠]]套牌的苏勒台掘坟也用上了[[card:Seasoned Cryomancer|干练凛寒术士]]，[[card:Something Worth Saving|应救之物]]相对[[card:Cache Grab|贪婪备储]]也是纯升级：deck:43587beb61363b53cb36

label.zh: 纯绿地落 · jtl005 · 第3名

text.en: Landfall decks have started trying [[card:Carnivorous Cultivator|Carnivorous Cultivator]], adding some copies of [[card:Elven Passage|Elven Passage]] and other utility lands as tutor targets. This build reached the Top 4: deck:37704608cf3168335752

text.en: Izzet Prowess continues to run the full playset of [[card:Pompous Battlemage|Pompous Battlemage]]. A version adding [[card:Stingcaster Mage|Stingcaster Mage]] and [[card:Clash of Elements|Clash of Elements]] reached the Top 8 this week: deck:9db4ea144f8aea4e897f
